test_title: PYST 36: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 20 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: E, F, G, H, J, K and L are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table (but not necessarily in the same order). K is an immediate neighbour of both L and G. G sits third to the left of F. E sits to the immediate left of F. H is NOT an immediate neighbour of G. Who sits third to the left of J?
solution:
Given: E, F, G, H, J, K and L are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table (but not necessarily in the same order). 

1) K is an immediate neighbour of both L and G.

2) G sits third to the left of F.

3) E sits to the immediate left of F.

4) H is NOT an immediate neighbour of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08a4756ef2cdfa430ed856409fd805171b4d712fd39769de0961a39fb4bcdf25.png] 

So, J will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3e14d918632a74373d1c84037850726bb2c2e28198632911081a32ac575e842.png] 

Here, **L **sits third to the left of J.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
